subject: Production key exposed in a shared channel, need it killed now
body: Urgent. One of our contractors pasted a live production API key into a shared vendor channel this morning. The channel has external members in it. The key looks like sk_test_REDACTED in our logs where it was used. We have deleted the message but I have to assume it was seen and copied. I need that credential revoked immediately, not at the next business day, and I need a full record of every call made with it since 06:00 UTC today so we can work out whether anything was touched. Please confirm as soon as it is dead. Our security lead is standing by.
